name: Business Practices
overview: Scripture instructs believers to conduct business with integrity and diligence, emphasizing fairness and honesty in all transactions. The Lord detests dishonesty, such as using false balances, and calls for just dealings without oppression (Leviticus 25:14; Proverbs 11:1). Wealth is recognized as a provision from God’s power, meant to uphold His covenant, and prosperity comes through diligent effort rather than slackness (Deuteronomy 8:18; Proverbs 10:4). Additionally, caution is urged against irresponsible financial commitments, such as guaranteeing debts, to avoid unnecessary burdens (Proverbs 22:26).
